text:
ana: Heads up — main is CI-red after I merged lockfile regen (merge 3f2b1a). Failing unit tests in python-3.11 matrix, looks like import/attribute error from packaging. Anyone around to quick triage? :eyes:

mike: On it, can you paste the failing traceback or job link?

ana: ci-bot: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/12345 — failing test snippet:

```
E   AttributeError: module 'packaging.version' has no attribute 'LegacyVersion'
  /workspace/redwood/vendor/serializer.py:42: in dumps
      v = packaging.version.LegacyVersion(...)
```

mike: weird, packaging 24 removed LegacyVersion. Did the lockfile pick up packaging 24.x as a transitive?

tara: yeah we had a constraints bump earlier. ana did the lock regen include new constraints? any lockfile diff?

ana: diff shows packaging 23.1 -> 24.0 in poetry.lock under transitive -> 'build-tools'. I didn't notice.

samir: easiest quick fix is force packaging<24 in our constraints file (constraints.txt / pyproject) until we update serializer to use packaging.Version API.

mike: I can repro locally quickly. Running tox -e py311 tests/unit/test_serializer.py

mike: Repro confirmed. Installing packaging==23.1 locally fixes the failing test.

ana: can someone open a small PR to pin? I'll follow up with a proper fix to serializer to avoid LegacyVersion.

samir: I'll open one now. Using diff:

```
- packaging >=23.0
+ packaging <24, >=23.0
```

and add note in changelog.

ci-bot: Build triggered for PR #9872 — running jobs

andy: quick Q — should we add a unit test asserting serializer uses public API so this won't regress again?

mike: yes add a test that imports packaging.Version and serializes expected output.

ana: PR #9872 merged, CI rerun on main :green_heart: — tests back to green. Thanks all :tada:

tara: can we also add a post-merge check on lock regen PRs that flags major-version bumps in critical deps?

samir: filed infra ticket INFRA-402 for automated constraint bump warnings.

ana: awesome, closing this thread.
